fb4f380e672669dda55551b0 description: A hunter does not carry thirty kilograms of steel to survive the wilderness. True discipline lies in packability and patience. The Henry AR-7 breaks down completely inside its own water-resistant stock. It was made for downed pilots and woodsmen who respect weight limits. Bring me sustenance from the forest and show me you can walk out alive, and this survival tool is yours.
fb4f380e672669dda55551b0 startedMessageT: Walk out of the forest alive, and bring me food and water you found yourself. That is all I ask.
fb4f380e672669dda55551b0 successMessageT: You walked out. That is the whole lesson. Take the rifle - it weighs nothing, and one day that will matter.
